messages:
alex: Quick sync — I sketched a launch gating draft for routing + multi-region tenant controls. Need product + infra alignment before we turn this into an RFC. Posting checklist + Acme asks (Elaine) inline.

morgan: thanks alex. high level: are we locking on affinity-first or cost-first for initial rollouts?

priya: re: Acme — they asked for per-tenant region pinning (data residency) and a dedicated SLA (99.9). They said they'd pay for dedicated capacity but want an integrated fallback plan.

kevin: ops flag — fallback has to avoid cross-region writes. if primary region fails we need read-only fallback + write-queueing or tenant-evacuation plan. also watch egress costs during failover.

alex: agree. goal: produce a minimal launch gating that covers Safety/Perf/Contracts. won't ship everything at once.

sasha: dropping a terse checklist for gating that we can iterate on:
```
must_have:
  - canary slices (5% traffic) + automated rollback on errors
  - perf_sla: p95 < 120ms for hosted; dedicated baselined separately
  - telemetry: per-tenant traces + user-visible error budgets
  - data_residency: region pin + explicit fallback policy (read-only or designated write queue)
  - compliance: KMS integration & audit logs for Private customers
  - customer_acceptance: signed SOW + pilot run for 2 weeks
```

elaine-sales: Acme confirms they'll accept a us-east-only pilot first. They want a clear rollback plan and will sign the SOW if the canary has no errors for 72h.

morgan: tradeoffs note — locking to region pinning reduces our scheduling flexibility and raises cost. we should define a tenant-class that allows pinning (enterprise only) to limit blast radius.

kevin: ops action — need a runbook for tenant evacuation. rough steps:
- mark tenant read-only
- sync KV cache to target region (if possible)
- spin up write-queueing service
- notify customer + routed traffic cutover

alex: good. propose owners + deadlines:
- Priya: finalize product gating checklist & pricing for pinned tenants — due Tue EOD
- Kevin: draft tenant evacuation runbook + infra tasks for fallback — due Wed
- Sasha: telemetry hooks & alerting thresholds for canary — due Tue
- Elaine: get Acme to sign pilot SOW by Wed EOD

ops-bot: scheduled reminder set for 3691100000 (pilot kickoff). :bell:

priya: I'll turn the checklist into a short RFC and attach expected cost delta for pinned tenants.

alex: thanks. if no major objections let's lock this scope and convert to RFC Monday. small follow-up: we need a decision on "tenant-class" labeling (enterprise/pinned/auto) — brief thumbs by EOD? :thumbsup: :thumbsdown:

morgan: +1

kevin: +1

elaine-sales: +1 from Acme side

sasha: +1

alex: awesome — we'll proceed. I'll post a draft RFC link when ready.
